plan.major: Air Conditioning and Refrigeration: Automation Fundamentals
plan.notes: Transcribed from the official El Camino College Program Pathways Mapper, "Air Conditioning and Refrigeration: Automation Fundamentals map for 2026-2027" (programmap.elcamino.edu, catalog year 2026-2027): https://programmap.elcamino.edu/pathway/air-conditioning-and-refrigeration-automation-fundamentals-to-career-2/?pt=map&year=2026. Pathway units/terms per mapper card: 7 units, 2 terms; modeled credit sum = 7. Course codes, titles, units, term placement, and major/GE/elective categories transcribed verbatim from the published term grids. Unit ranges are modeled at the source lower bound with the range documented in choice_note. GE choice slots ("Any ... Area ... course") follow the published option lists; the mapper recommends meeting with a counselor for GE selection. The pathway flags some courses as having prerequisites, but the mapper's published prerequisite text is internally inconsistent (e.g., the Beginning Piano I course page lists Nursing courses as prerequisites; the General Chemistry I page lists a duplicated entry), so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official El Camino College catalog course descriptions for prerequisites.
